scope: attack E01–12 / W01–12, hit E01–06 / W01–06, total 36 frames; static image review only

staticCroppingOverall: no visible cut-off antler, ear, tail or hoof

findings.description: W06 changes head tilt and retracts the near forehoof relative to W05 and W07. Anatomy remains acceptable; normal and slow playback should establish whether this reads as an intentional force phase or a one-frame motion reversal.
Peak recoil to near-neutral recovery is concentrated in the 03→04 transition. No chest/back switch; check timing and recoil snap in actual playback.
Small scarf tip extends to screen-right at recoil peak and disappears again on recovery; likely cloth flick, but root may review attachment continuity.

exclusions: No inference that static review proves animation smoothness, exact timing, alpha correctness, unique AI generation or game integration.
